findingClass: our published OPEN/UPCOMING set disagrees with the exchange that actually runs the issue
round7Findings: T-340 (new coverage — no round-7 finding; our live status set had NO independent oracle at all)
failThreshold: any MAINBOARD row naming NSE among its listing exchanges where (a) we publish OPEN but NSE current-issue does not list it, (b) NSE current-issue lists it as open while we publish UPCOMING or no OPEN row, or (c) an NSE current/upcoming issue has no OPEN/UPCOMING row of ours at all. Scope excludes SME (NSE Emerge is not on these endpoints), BSE-only rows, and rows with unknown listing exchanges — FAILing those would be noise, and a muted channel is a dead mechanism.
unverifiableWhen: the NSE cookie handshake or either feed fetch fails, or both feeds return zero usable rows (indistinguishable from a broken feed, so never read as "nothing is open today"). UNVERIFIABLE pages and exits 3 — never a silent PASS (T-321 class).
